shortDescription: UPSSSC Lower PCS Mains Exam Fee Payment 2026 open. Pay fee on upsssc.gov.in before last date.
content:
Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has activated the Lower PCS Mains Examination Fee Payment 2026 facility for eligible candidates.

Candidates shortlisted for Mains must submit the prescribed fee online within the given window. Failure to pay may result in non-issuance of Mains admit card.

Steps

  1. Login on upsssc.gov.in
  2. Open Mains fee payment link
  3. Pay online and save receipt
  4. Track admit card release after fee closing date
